unverified_gap_future_intent.text: While I don’t have verified experimentation experience, I am eager to grow in this area and contribute to the team’s goals.

verified_candidate_growth_must_not_repai.text: I am eager to grow conversion and improve outcomes for the team.

safe_response_cardinality_resources_appr.text: Назовите 2–3 ресурса или подхода, которые вы бы использовали для быстрого изучения основ автоматизации тестирования в рамках периода адаптации.

unsafe_unsourced_duration.text: Опишите, как вы освоите основы автоматизации за 2–3 дня.

policy.motivation_repair: A candidate_fit paragraph may be reclassified to motivation only when it has explicit future intent, vacancy evidence, and either no candidate evidence or candidate evidence consisting exclusively of explicit unverified-gap facts that the paragraph itself discloses. Verified skills, achievements and impact are never repaired.
policy.response_cardinality: Imperative interview requests for a count of examples/options/steps/reasons/resources/approaches are answer-format instructions, not factual claims. Durations, percentages, salaries, experience numbers and outcomes remain hard-gated.
policy.production_boundary: The hotfix changes only the isolated AI-BENCH harness, prompts, regressions, tests and documentation. No production AI route, provider service, model or database migration is introduced.
